purpose: Visual request for physical servo caliper readings, retaining numbers 1, 4 and 5 from the fit investigation
method: Built-in image_gen image editing; annotations reviewed against the supplied drawing

measurement_numbers.1: Mounting-ear underside/rear face to flat rear/bottom case face
measurement_numbers.4: Bare shaft tip to flat rear/bottom case face
measurement_numbers.5: Main case length excluding the mounting ears

prompt: Edit the supplied manufacturer drawing into a clear caliper markup. Preserve the two servo views and geometry. Remove the specification table and original dimension values. Label measurement 1 in blue from the mounting-ear LOWER face to the bottom case face, with a magnified lower-face inset. Label measurement 4 in red from the bare shaft tip to the bottom case face. Label measurement 5 in green across the main case only, excluding the ears. Keep original measurement numbers, show no expected values, and provide reply blanks in mm. State that housing measurements 2 and 3 come next.
correction_prompt: Move measurement 1's upper endpoint dot, extension line and arrowhead from the middle of the ear flange to its exact underside/bottom edge. Preserve the servo photographs, other arrows, text and reply blanks.
limitations: A measurement-location illustration. It is not a dimensionally calibrated image, native CAD render, or validation of hardware fit. No caliper readings have been supplied.
